Episode es una plataforma pan-europea de living respaldada por capital institucional, con foco en España, Francia e Italia y presencia operativa en Madrid y Barcelona. Nuestro producto: unidades privadas totalmente equipadas con suministros incluidos, contratos flexibles y zonas comunes diseñadas para trabajar, mantenerse activo y compartir. El perfil seleccionado será el máximo responsable del P&L, la operación y la experiencia de cliente de ambos activos, con la misión de maximizar su rendimiento y rentabilidad garantizando una experiencia diferencial, una operación eficiente y una cultura de alto rendimiento. El puesto combina visión de negocio y ejecución hands-on: entender el negocio en su conjunto, interpretar sus indicadores, identificar oportunidades y riesgos y convertirlos rápidamente en decisiones y planes de acción. Responsabilidades Principales Desempeño financiero y desarrollo de negocio: P&L y Business Plan: Asumir la responsabilidad sobre el P&L de los activos y asegurar su evolución de acuerdo con el Business Plan, participando activamente en la elaboración de presupuestos y forecasts. Seguimiento y acción correctiva: Analizar mensualmente el desempeño frente a presupuesto, forecast y Business Plan, identificar desviaciones y sus causas y liderar las acciones correctivas. Rentabilidad: Identificar oportunidades para incrementar ingresos, mejorar márgenes y optimizar la estructura de costes. Cobros y morosidad: Supervisar de forma proactiva cobros, deuda de clientes y riesgos de impago. Revenue y desarrollo comercial: Palancas de ingresos: Monitorizar y optimizar ocupación, tarifas, renovaciones y canales de venta, trabajando con el equipo comercial para maximizar ocupación y rentabilidad. Mercado y competencia: Identificar cambios en demanda, comportamiento del cliente y entorno competitivo que puedan afectar al rendimiento. Nuevas oportunidades: Evaluar oportunidades comerciales desde una perspectiva de rentabilidad y capacidad operativa, asegurando su coherencia con la propuesta de valor y el posicionamiento de Episode. Excelencia operativa: Operación integral: Supervisar la operación de ambos activos, asegurando la implementación y el cumplimiento de procesos, procedimientos y estándares de Episode. Mejora continua: Identificar ineficiencias, riesgos y oportunidades de mejora, y liderar iniciativas que eleven productividad, calidad y eficiencia. Escalabilidad: Crear procesos escalables que mantengan una experiencia consistente a medida que Episode crece, coordinando de forma eficaz a los equipos de los activos con los departamentos corporativos. Gestión por datos: Utilizar KPIs operativos para anticipar problemas y tomar decisiones. Experiencia de cliente: Estancia completa: Garantizar una experiencia fluida y consistente con el posicionamiento premium de Episode, desde el check-in hasta la salida y la renovación. Incidencias: Liderar la gestión de incidencias y reclamaciones relevantes con respuestas rápidas y orientadas a solución. Comunidad y fidelización: Promover iniciativas que refuercen la fidelización y el sentido de comunidad, maximizando el uso y el valor percibido de las zonas comunes. Voz del cliente: Convertir el feedback de clientes y redes sociales en mejoras de la propuesta de valor. Equipos: Liderazgo: Liderar, desarrollar y motivar a los equipos y responsables de departamento de ambos activos, fijando objetivos claros y midiendo el desempeño individual y colectivo. Talento: Identificar, desarrollar y retener talento clave, desarrollando a los mandos intermedios para incrementar la autonomía de los equipos. Cultura: Construir una cultura de responsabilidad, colaboración y alto rendimiento, gestionando situaciones complejas y procesos de cambio con empatía y determinación. Activos, cumplimiento y colaboradores: Conservación del activo: Supervisar los programas de mantenimiento preventivo y correctivo, protegiendo la calidad y el valor físico de los inmuebles. Seguridad y normativa: Garantizar el cumplimiento de los protocolos de seguridad y emergencia y de la legislación, regulación y ordenanzas aplicables, identificando y gestionando riesgos operativos y regulatorios. Representación: Construir relaciones sólidas con proveedores y partners estratégicos, mantener una relación constructiva con autoridades y organismos públicos y representar a Episode frente a clientes, empleados y colaboradores externos. Perfil Buscado Experiencia: 5–8 años en posiciones de liderazgo operativo o de negocio, de los cuales al menos 3 gestionando operaciones multi-site con responsabilidad sobre P&L, en hospitality, flex living, serviced apartments, coliving, build-to-rent, residencias de estudiantes o sectores afines. Gestión de equipos: Experiencia acreditada liderando equipos multidisciplinares y desarrollando mandos intermedios. Entornos de crecimiento: Experiencia en aperturas, procesos de transformación o profesionalización de operaciones. Competencia financiera: Sólidos conocimientos de gestión financiera, P&L, management accounts y procedimientos contables; capacidad para elaborar y ejecutar business plans y para interpretar resultados financieros y KPIs. Formación: Grado universitario. Se valorará formación en Hospitality/Hotel Management o Administración de Empresas, sin ser excluyente si la experiencia de negocio y operaciones es equivalente. No buscamos necesariamente un perfil puramente hotelero: valoraremos especialmente profesionales procedentes de hoteles, apartamentos, flex living, coliving, build-to-rent o residencias de estudiantes. Idiomas: Castellano e inglés profesional imprescindibles. Competencias Personales Visión de negocio y pensamiento analítico, con capacidad para convertir datos en decisiones y acciones concretas. Liderazgo motivador e inspirador, con alta inteligencia emocional y capacidad para generar compromiso y desarrollar talento. Orientación a resultados y autonomía para asumir la responsabilidad sobre el desempeño del negocio, tomando decisiones con criterio empresarial. Capacidad para evaluar y mejorar procesos y sistemas, impulsando la eficiencia y la mejora continua. Organización y gestión estructurada de múltiples prioridades entre distintos activos, equipos y colaboradores, manteniendo una visión global del negocio. Orientación a la excelencia operativa, la calidad del servicio y la experiencia del cliente, equilibrando satisfacción, eficiencia y rentabilidad. Excelentes habilidades de comunicación y capacidad para construir relaciones de confianza con clientes, equipos, partners y administraciones. Compromiso con el cumplimiento normativo y la gestión responsable de riesgos. ¿Qué ofrecemos? Incorporación a una plataforma pan-europea de living en crecimiento, respaldada por un inversor institucional de primer nivel. Responsabilidad plena sobre el P&L y la operación de dos activos, con autonomía real en la toma de decisiones. review_candidates.title: Health Sector Specialist - based in Luxembourg
review_candidates.description: This position is based at our Luxembourg headquarters and requires regular office presence. The EIB offers you the opportunity to live and work in a truly international and multi-cultural environment. We also offer relocation support. The EIB, the European Union's bank is seeking to recruit for its Projects Directorate (PJ) - Innovation and Competitiveness Department (INCO) – Life Sciences and Health Division (LSH) at its headquarters in Luxembourg, a Health Sector Specialist * . internal benchmark : Sector Economist/Engineer This is a full-time position at grade 5 for which the EIB offers a two-year contract. Panel interviews are anticipated for second half of September 2026. If you're passionate about shaping the future of healthcare through impactful investments and partnerships, this is your chance to contribute at the highest level. At the European Investment Bank, you'll be part of a mission-driven team that blends deep sector expertise with a strategic vision—evaluating and guiding projects that support innovation, sustainability, and societal resilience across Europe and beyond. This role offers a unique opportunity to work at the crossroads of policy, finance, and health sector, collaborating with top experts and institutions to deliver real-world change. Purpose The Project Directorate’s (PJ) mission is to provide independent advice to the EIB’s decision makers on the sector policy to be followed and on the quality of investment projects to be financed, advising promoters on the design, preparation and implementation of their projects as well as monitoring the implementation of the ongoing investment projects. To accomplish its role, PJ is mainly staffed with sector experts (Engineers, Economists, Environmental, Climate and Social experts, Procurement experts), who work together in multi-disciplinary project teams, and in a close contact with the other EIB operational services. The Life Sciences and Health Division (LSH), part of the Innovation and Competitiveness Department (INCO) of PJ covers the health sector, pharmaceuticals, diagnostics, medical device technology and the wider life sciences industries. This Division supports and actively contributes to the Bank’s strategy with respect to its lending program on Innovation, Digitalization and Human Capital, in line with the relevant strategic priorities of the EIB (Climate action and environmental sustainability, Digitalisation and technological innovation, Security and defence, A modern cohesion policy, Social infrastructure, High-impact global investment). The successful candidate will focus in particular on health sector projects, predominantly (but not exclusively) being implemented across the EU territory. The Health Specialist assesses, within multi-disciplinary teams, the technical and economic viability as well as procurement standards and environmental, climate and social sustainability of investment projects related to the Health Sector , in all countries where the Bank operates. These activities are performed in the context of the EIB’s due diligence process, which involves, among other activities, the review of the technical documentation received from the promoter, the preparation of an appraisal report summarizing the findings as well as other relevant documents for the internal processing of the operation, using a risk-based approach. Upon approval of these projects, s/he also has an active role in the implementation support and monitoring of a project until its completion. S/he would also contribute to sectoral studies, policies review and other transversal activities in her/his field of expertise, in relation to relevant sector related aspects. The Health Specialist also contributes to or coordinates Technical Assistance assignments in his/ her area of expertise for projects approved, or to be approved within the division/ department. You will be required to travel to project locations within and outside of the EU (normally short trips of 2-4 days, depending on the project location). Operating Network As a Health Specialist, you’ll be at the heart of a dynamic team driving forward strategic health initiatives. Reporting to the Head of the Life Sciences and Health Division (LSH), you’ll collaborate closely with experienced professionals across the Innovation and Competitiveness (INCO) Department and the wider Projects Directorate. You will partner with internal INCO and LSH experts, other Bank services, external stakeholders, public authorities, private companies and EU institutions—your role will be pivotal in aligning investments with broader European health, strategic autonomy, economic resilience and innovation goals. The ideal candidate will thrive in an autonomous role while embracing collaboration within and across teams, building and maintaining strong connections with external partners. Accountabilities As a Health Specialist, you will play a vital role in shaping and evaluating high-impact investments in the health sector. This position offers a dynamic opportunity to influence policy, drive sustainable development, and collaborate with diverse teams across the European Investment Bank (EIB). What You'll Be Doing Strategic Evaluation Assess health projects for strategic policy alignment, technical soundness, financial viability, and sustainability—documenting outcomes in comprehensive but focused appraisal reports. Project Monitoring & Implementation Support Oversee implementation phases including final evaluation and follow-up; offer hands-on support to ensure successful use of funds to receive the desired outcomes. Sustainability Leadership Apply and monitor EIB standards across Climate, Environmental, Social, and Procurement dimensions to uphold best-in-class governance and full alignment with the Bank's standards. Technical Assistance Provide guidance and support to project promoters through tailored technical assistance. Teamwide Support Support other divisions in evaluating and delivering projects that feature health components. Strategic Contribution Participate in other key sector initiatives and priority activities identified by the Bank, Directorate, Department, or Division. Cross-Functional Collaboration Partner with the Bank’s Operational and Global Directorates and to identify investment opportunities aligned with country-specific priorities and strategic goals. Policy & Sector Development Contribute to the Bank's sector policies by drafting and developing policy, methodologies, and sector-specific papers within your area of expertise. Insightful Sector Updates Produce regular briefings and sector updates to inform internal stakeholders and guide strategic planning and policy shaping. Continuous Learning Stay on top of emerging trends, best practices, and legislative changes—sharing key insights with colleagues across the organization. Qualifications University degree (minimum an equivalent to a Bachelor) in medical, economic, technical or similar fields; a post-graduate degree at Master’s level or equivalent in health economics, health management, health engineering, public health, or another equivalent specialisation relevant for the health sector would be an asset; Minimum of 5 years (ideally 8 - 12years) of relevant professional experience in the health sector covering the main aspects of the standard project cycle (feasibility, design, implementation/development, management and operation) and in particular in relation to large-scale health projects and programs in at least three countries, including low and medium income countries Very good knowledge of the health sector policies, organization and functioning, including the global and EU policies and current trends, with particular focus on health systems organization and financing, Sustainable Development Goals and economics of health investments (economic rate of return, financial rate of return, NPV, etc.) Professional experience in providing advisory services / technical assistance gained with a consultancy, corporate, research institute or financial institution; Excellent writing skills and ability to conceptualise and draft specific sharp reports, sector studies, papers and policy briefings for a wider audience; Excellent knowledge of English. A very good command of French (***) would be a distinct advantage. Advantage Professional experience working for or in Low- and Middle-Income Countries health sectors could be considered as advantage; Knowledge of other EU languages would be a distinct advantage. Competencies Find Out More About EIB Core Behavioural Skills Here To find out more about our eligibility criteria click here (***) Unless stated explicitly as a required qualification, a good command of French is not a pre-requisite for hire. As both English and French are however official working languages of the EIB, proficiency in both languages is a pre-requisite for your future career development. Any language clause in your contract must be fulfilled in order for you to be eligible for a promotion (either via the annual appraisal cycle or via an internal selection process). Proficiency is understood to mean the attainment of level 5 of the Inter Institutional language courses, corresponding to B1.2 of the Common European Framework of Reference for Languages (CEFRL). The Bank offers appropriate training support. We hire and value talent with unique characteristics, creating a work environment where they can be themselves. We believe that Diversity, Equity and Inclusion makes us a performing and innovative organisation. We encourage all suitably qualified and eligible candidates to apply regardless of their gender identity/expression, age, racial, ethnic and cultural background, religion and beliefs, sexual orientation, disability or neurodiversity. If you require reasonable accommodation during the recruitment process due to a disability, neurodivergence, or a chronic health condition, please contact the EIB Recruitment team Jobs@eib.org who will manage your request appropriately. By applying for this position, you acknowledge the importance of maintaining the security and integrity of the Information of the EIB Group. In case of selection for the position you agree to comply with all measures (policies, controls, document classification and management) implemented by the EIB Group to prevent unauthorised disclosure of any information or any damage to the EIB Group reputation. This is an open campaign to consecutively fill open positions. The campaign will remain open until position is filled. Applications will be reviewed in order of receipt. If you are interested in the position, we encourage you to apply early, as initial decisions are typically made within the first three weeks of the campaign.
